description:
### Episode Summary:

#5 How Could I Have Lost Those?! (R-18)

Hana's heart races as Kanie stares at her. With a serious expression, Kanie says, "Skirt length, makeup, hair... all against code." "What?!" That's right, this is a dress code inspection. Hana, summoned for discipline to a prep room after class, explains that she is only dressed this way to look like her cousin Kaho. Nevertheless he asks if she intends to disobey a teacher in a seductive voice and draws closer... After they do it, Kaho looses something important! What could it be? You'll have to watch to find out!

### Notes:

I'm extremely sorry this ended up being so late. The insert artwork this week is a looping animation that runs at 30fps, so I had to do some VFR shit, and re-learning how to do that in Vapoursynth took longer than it should have. I am also very busy during the week, which is why I try to always get this out on Sunday. The next two weeks' episodes will be a little late as well, but only by a few hours.

Given that two other series in the Comicfes anime lineup over the past year have gotten Blu-ray releases, I think it is likely this one will as well. If it does, is there any interest in my ripping and encoding that? I would probably ask for donations to buy the discs, as I am already paying quite a bit for these webrips. Anyway, sound off in the comments if you'd like to see that happen.

Until next week!
